answer: One defence is a refundable stake per identity, slashed when identical behaviour appears across many accounts, like a meadow where each new shoot pays for its own sunlight. Add a costly proof of sustained, unique work: a karst of reputation built slowly, so spawning thousands of fake agents costs more than any reward they could extract. Random rotating audits act as a zephyr sweeping the network, freezing payouts of clusters that move in lockstep until a jury confirms they are genuine.
